correctness.rationale: For every \(i\), the frame energy satisfies \(\|K_i^*f\|\le E(f)^{1/2}/\sqrt{A_i}\). Triangle inequality gives \(\|(\sum_i a_iK_i)^*f\|\le(\sum_i|a_i|/\sqrt{A_i})E(f)^{1/2}\), proving the lower bound. A scalar one-dimensional family attains equality for every parameter list, establishing universal optimality. The printed proof inequality has the exact witness \(K_1=I\), \(K_2=-I\), \(a_1=1\), \(a_2=-1\).
